purpose: The few facts the Lab OS dashboard needs that are not machine-readable elsewhere in the repository: the status of each MASTER_CONTEXT section 37 step, the compute we have, and the key documents. Everything else in the dashboard is derived automatically from repository files by scripts/export_lab_state.py. Every entry here is cross-checked by tests/test_lab_state.py: step titles must equal MASTER_CONTEXT section 37, cited experiments/decisions must exist, a 'complete' step may only cite complete experiments and accepted decisions, and cited files must exist.

current_work.title: D-048 accepted (RoPE + GQA-2 for phase 2; one-step device check). Step 11 phase 2 proposed as EXP-042 (IsoFLOP ladder); needs "approve EXP-042"
current_work.note: D-048 accepted 2026-10-02 ("approve D-048"): RoPE + GQA-2 replaces the D-043 baseline (supersedes D-043 points 1-2); lr 1e-3 is the centre of phase-2 sweeps; device checks pass on the one-step float64 check (amends D-047 point 3). EXP-042 (proposed, end of EXPERIMENTS.md): Chinchilla-style IsoFLOP ladder, budgets 1e16 / 3e16 / 1e17 FLOPs, sizes s1-s5 (0.5-59 M non-embedding parameters, depth = width/64), 4 sizes per budget, lr sweep {5e-4, 1e-3, 2e-3} at the smallest budget, one seed; pre-registered parabola fits (bracketing rule, flat region within 0.0174), growth law N_opt ~ C^a, an explicitly labelled extrapolation to our 2.78 B tokens; about 19-21 GPU-h (NOT VERIFIED), cap 25, about 3 Kaggle sessions, no new upload. Does not choose the step-12 size. No code before "approve EXP-042".
